title: archidendron pellitum
intro: Archidendron pellitum, commonly known as the "Sea Almond" or "Keluak", is a type of tree native to tropical regions of the Pacific and Indian Oceans. The Sea Almond tree produces a fruit that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief for various health issues. The fruit of the Archidendron pellitum has been shown to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the Archidendron pellitum fruit include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
